drafts.walkScript: At line 29 Stuart would bet 'four thousand pounds'. At line 40 Fogg's answer is 'Deal over again', about the cards. At line 46 he raises it to 'twenty thousand'. At line 81, with the bet signed, he says 'Diamonds are trumps'. So the stakes keep rising, but he keeps answering about the cards.

Line 3 calls the blue chair 'a waiting chair'. Lines 3 to 5 say Farhan sat there, got a pencil, and his photograph went up. At line 47 Dilan stands, 'because you stand up when somebody is about to thank you'. So he expects the same sort of thanks that Farhan got. The handle at line 44 shows when he stands, not why.
